name: office-dav-poc
description: POC: edit Office files over WebDAV through a pluggable gateway

scripts.dev: node scripts/preflight.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names demo,dav --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/demo-site" "npm run dev -w services/dav-service"
scripts.start: node scripts/preflight.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names demo,dav --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run start -w apps/demo-site" "npm run start -w services/dav-service"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w packages/gateway-contract -w services/dav-service -w apps/demo-site
